name: lineage2-style-game
description: Chronicle Elfs - 3D top-down MMORPG-style game inspired by Lineage 2, built with Three.js + Vite. Includes PWA support and Capacitor Android wrapper for APK builds.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
